faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) for filling project-based research positions under an ICMR Extramural Grant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by MAHE?
faq.answer: MAHE has advertised for the position of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post in this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Pharm or MSc degree with a specialization in Pharmaceutics, Industrial Pharmacy, Pharmacology, or Pharmaceutical Chemistry with first or second class.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 56,000/- along with 10% HRA, totaling Rs. 61,600/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for MAHE Project Research Scientist-I Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of detailed curriculum vitae (CV) via email is October 4, 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their detailed CV and required documents through email to the designated official email address.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to this position?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for applying to this project research scientist position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for MAHE Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview for shortlisted individuals.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their application CV?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their detailed CV via email to [email protected] on or before the specified last date of October 4, 2026.
